title: Sheinbaum Announces Support Measures for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises
author: Alonso Urrutia and Emir Olivares
content:
_This article by Alonso Urrutia and Emir Olivares originally appeared in
the[September 11, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/2026/09/11/economia/016n3eco), Mexico's
premier left-wing daily newspaper._

The federal government will implement administrative measures to support
micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises, among them the streamlining and
consolidation of procedures, as well as tax incentives, announced President
Claudia Sheinbaum.

One of these provisions consists of offering an option for the payment of the
value-added tax (VAT), which involves **paying a rate of only 7 percent with
no right to a refund** , or keeping the 15 percent rate with the possibility
of having a portion refunded.

> "The small businesses told us that it takes them a long time to do the
> accounting to recover the VAT. The Tax Administration Service (SAT) proposes
> to them that, if they want to continue with that regime, that's fine; if
> not, there is an option: pay 7 percent VAT and that's it. How did that 7
> percent come about? It is the average of what MSMEs normally cover between
> what they pay and what they recover."

For his part, the head of the SAT, Antonio Martínez Dagnino, stated that there
are currently **4,178,276 taxpayers** , both individuals and micro-businesses,
considered as such because they have annual income of up to 3.5 million pesos
(the limit will rise to 5 million). In the primary sector, he detailed, the
income exempt from income tax will be increased, which is currently 900,000
pesos and will go up to one million pesos.

## The IMSS Will Simplify and Advise on Procedures

The general director of the Mexican Social Security Institute (IMSS), Zoé
Robledo, explained that there are 665,000 employer registrations with fewer
than 10 workers. These businesses are offered an administrative simplification
consisting of the digitalization of procedures and permanent support to
facilitate their relationship with the agency.

Robledo also highlighted that in the forms for new micro-enterprises, the
required response fields will be **reduced from 80 to 14** , since much of the
information is already held by the SAT and an interconnection is being created
so that the IMSS only requires basic additional information.
